Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Scientist specializing in Computer Vision and complex motion analysis to work on a world-class sports performance solution. You will work closely with the client's team, taking ownership of technical solutions, making informed technical decisions, and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Qualifications Hands-on experience developing and deploying computer vision systems to production. Strong Computer Vision expertise in: Object and people detection. Motion analysis and understanding of complex movement patterns. 2D pose estimation or other advanced motion analysis techniques. Object tracking using modern computer vision methods. Temporal modeling across video sequences. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch. Experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating deep learning models. Comfortable with dataset curation, annotation workflows, and model evaluation metrics. Experience working with video involving complex or fast movements, including challenges such as high frame rates, motion blur, and occlusions. Experience with custom pose estimation approaches, including developing or adapting existing models, skeleton structures, or keypoint definitions. Ability to independently design technical solutions, evaluate different approaches, and make informed technical decisions. Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and the ability to work with minimal supervision. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical decisions, discuss trade-offs, and collaborate directly with client teams. Strong Plus: Experience with 3D pose estimation or 2D-to-3D pose lifting from video. Experience generating and rendering synthetic data for model training. Nice to Have Familiarity with biomechanics, human movement analysis, or movement screening. Experience working in a Microsoft Azure environment. Previous experience with Sports AI or sports performance analytics. Description: Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. Job Summary The Supplier Master Data Analyst serves as the primary point of contact for employees, suppliers, and business stakeholders, delivering high-quality support across Supplier Information Management (SIM) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes. This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and governance of supplier master data to support procurement, invoice processing, payment execution, compliance requirements, and supplier lifecycle management. The position plays a critical role in maintaining supplier data quality across enterprise systems while ensuring adherence to corporate policies, internal controls, regulatory requirements, and master data governance standards. The Analyst will support supplier onboarding, supplier maintenance, data validation, risk and compliance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and user experience. This role requires strong experience with ERP and procurement platforms (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba), supplier master data governance, workflow management, and data quality processes. The successful candidate will demonstrate exceptional attention to detail, analytical capabilities, customer service skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders in a fast-paced shared services environment. This role follows a hybrid work schedule and is based in Monterrey, Mexico. Core Responsibilities Serve as the regional point of contact for business units, suppliers, procurement teams, accounts payable, and other stakeholders regarding supplier master data requests and inquiries. Process supplier onboarding, supplier changes, banking updates, tax information updates, and supplier deactivation requests while ensuring compliance with company policies and data governance standards. Review and validate supplier documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, regulatory compliance, and adherence to internal controls. Maintain supplier master records across ERP, procurement, and workflow systems while ensuring data integrity and consistency. Perform data quality reviews, duplicate analysis, supplier record audits, and data cleansing activities to improve overall master data accuracy. Conduct root cause analysis of supplier data issues and implement corrective and preventive actions to improve process effectiveness. Support supplier onboarding and enablement activities, ensuring a positive supplier experience throughout the supplier lifecycle. Provide functional support and training to end users on supplier master data processes, policies, controls, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Communicate professionally with suppliers and internal stakeholders through written and verbal channels to resolve inquiries and requests. Identify opportunities to automate, streamline, and standardize supplier data management processes while strengthening governance and compliance controls. Collaborate with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Compliance, Tax, Treasury, and Master Data Governance teams on cross-functional initiatives. Support reporting, metrics, and KPI monitoring related to supplier onboarding, data quality, service levels, and operational performance. Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), system implementations, upgrades, and process enhancement initiatives. Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate documentation and demonstrating compliance with established controls. Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned, including support for transformation, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Understanding of supplier master data governance, internal controls, compliance requirements, and risk management practices. Ability to interpret and consistently apply policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure compliance and sound decision-making. Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes, and process improvement opportunities. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high levels of data accuracy and integrity. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate effectively across all organizational levels. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams and functions. Experience managing escalated or complex supplier data issues and serving as a subject matter expert. Continuous improvement mindset with experience supporting process optimization, automation, and operational excellence initiatives. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools for reporting, reconciliation, and data quality management. Experience And Skills 3+ years of experience in Supplier Master Data, Supplier Information Management (SIM), Vendor Master, Master Data Management, or related shared services functions. Experience supporting supplier onboarding, supplier lifecycle management, and supplier data governance processes. Strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, including procurement, supplier setup, invoice processing, payment execution, and supplier maintenance. Experience working in a high-volume Global Business Services (GBS), Shared Services, or Finance Operations environment. Demonstrated ability to resolve supplier and stakeholder inquiries independently while meeting service level agreements (SLAs). Experience performing data quality analysis, data validation, reporting, and master data governance activities. Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. Experience supporting process improvement, automation, workflow optimization, or digital transformation initiatives is preferred. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Supplier Master Data, Master Data Management, Procurement Operations, Shared Services, or related functions. Hands-on experience with supplier onboarding, supplier maintenance, and master data governance processes. Proficiency with ERP and procurement platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba, PeopleSoft, or similar enterprise applications. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, lookups, pivot tables, and data validation techniques. Experience with master data management tools, workflow platforms, data quality solutions, or governance applications (e.g., Informatica, ServiceNow, MDM platforms) preferred. Familiarity with automation technologies, AI-enabled solutions, robotic process automation (RPA), and workflow tools is a plus. Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency preferred. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Title: Hub Planning Senior Lead
Description: Objetivo: Liderar y asegurar los procesos de Planeación Operativa y Táctica de Supply Chain para Caribe y las OpCos de la región Américas, integrando la planeación de demanda, producción, importaciones de producto terminado y distribución, garantizando su alineación con los estándares y metodologías globales de HEINEKEN y proporcionando información e insights clave para la toma de decisiones dentro del ciclo de Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP). Actividades principales: Diseñar y asegurar la implementación de los procesos de Planeación, definiendo claramente el alcance, roles y responsabilidades entre el Hub y las OpCos. Desarrollar los planes de Demanda y Suministro, dando seguimiento a los principales KPIs asociados a cada proceso. Generar el pronóstico estadístico base (Statistical Baseline Forecast) mediante procesos de depuración y modelado, así como gestionar su enriquecimiento y colaboración con S&OP y las áreas Comerciales de las OpCos. Consolidar y oficializar los planes de Demanda de corto y mediano plazo para las diferentes áreas de la organización. Proponer y definir, en conjunto con las OpCos, el Demand Plan que será utilizado como input para el ciclo de ROFO. Desarrollar los planes operativos y tácticos de producción, tanto de elaboración (Brewing) como de envasado (Packaging), considerando horizontes de corto, mediano y largo plazo. Definir el Plan de Producción con base en el forecast, las restricciones de Supply Chain y el análisis de inventarios, buscando maximizar la producción y reducir riesgos de disponibilidad de producto. Elaborar los planes de importación de producto terminado de corto, mediano y largo plazo. Desarrollar los planes de reabastecimiento (Replenishment) operativos y tácticos, definiendo el flujo óptimo de producto desde las cervecerías hacia los Centros de Distribución. Calcular y actualizar anualmente las políticas de inventario de Producto Terminado. Analizar y acordar con las OpCos los cambios necesarios en los planes de suministro, realizando los ajustes correspondientes y oficializando los planes de corto y mediano plazo. Generar, monitorear y comunicar los principales KPIs de Demanda y Suministro, incluyendo Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, Production Availability, Fill Rate y Production Plan Stability. Administrar los datos maestros de Demanda y Suministro dentro de las herramientas de Planeación, asegurando la calidad y precisión de información relacionada con clientes, productos, recursos de la red, entre otros. Participar activamente en las sesiones de Demand Review, Supply Review y Alignment Review del ciclo local de S&OP, siendo una fuente clave de datos e información para la toma de decisiones. Identificar benchmarks, mejores prácticas y oportunidades de innovación provenientes de otras OpCos para fortalecer y evolucionar continuamente los procesos de Planeación. Requisitos: Experiencia: 4 a 5 años de experiencia en áreas de Planeación de Supply Chain. Carrera profesional terminada. Nivel de inglés: Avanzado / fluido. Disponibilidad para viajar: Baja, aproximadamente 1 a 2 viajes al año. Conocimientos y experiencia: Demand & Supply Planning, Replenishment & Inventory Planning, Materials Requirement Planning (MRP) y Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP). Competencias: Perfil altamente proactivo y autónomo, con fuerte capacidad para la resolución de problemas. Alta capacidad y agilidad de aprendizaje, curiosidad y disposición para desarrollarse y colaborar de manera cross-functional. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, networking y manejo de stakeholders. Fuertes habilidades analíticas, capacidad para interpretar datos e indicadores y traducirlos en información relevante para el negocio.
